reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is physically problematic: copper has negligible solubility in tungsten and will not form coherent nanoprecipitates; instead, it will segregate to grain boundaries, likely causing severe embrittlement and loss of structural integrity.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, with specific quantitative falsification criteria, though it does not address the fundamental issue of Cu-W immiscibility.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a metallurgically unsound premise (coherent Cu nanoprecipitates in a W-based matrix) and would misdirect research effort.
